Brown Indian Basmati Rice - Alwalimah - 500g
Onion, White, Diced - 100g
Tomatoes, Diced - 100g
Whole Kernel Corn - Freshly - 100g
Green Peas - Tomex - 50g
Garlic, Chopped - 10g
Seasoned Broth For Arroz Amarillo - 2.04kg
details.method:
Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain and set aside.
In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and carrot to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened, about 5-7
minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the diced tomato, corn kernels, and green peas. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the tomato begins to break down.
Add the rice to the pot and stir to coat it with the vegetables and oil.
Pour the seasoned broth into the pot with the rice and vegetables. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has
been absorbed.
Once the rice is cooked, fluff it and let it sit covered for a few minutes before serving.

details.ingredients:
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 1kg
Fish Patties/ Breaded - 180g
details.method:
Heat oil in a pan.
When the oil is hot, place the fish patties in the hot oil one by one. Don't fry a lot at once; fry in batches.
Fried each side for about 2 to 3 minutes or until golden on both sides. Make sure the center is cooked evenly.

details.ingredients:
Potato, Cube - 2kg
Coriander Powder - Alkeif - Hot - 20g
Cumin Powder - Alkeif - Hot - 20g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 20g
Tomato Puree Mix For Aloo Shak - 60g
Coriander, Chopped - 300g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 60g
Mustard Seed - Atayeb - 20g
Cumin Whole - Alkeif - Hot - 20g
Turmeric Powder - Almanakhel - 10g
Red Chili Powder - Mehran - 20g
Water - 900ml
details.method:
Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium flame and make sure the lid is set aside within easy reach.
This is because the seeds may pop out from the hot oil when the potatoes are added.
Test the oil by adding a couple of mustard and cumin seeds. If they fizzle around, it’s ready so add the rest and then quickly add the
chopped potatoes and cover with the lid
Turn the heat down and then add the turmeric, chili powder, coriander and cumin powder and salt
Pour over the water and purée mix, cover and leave to cook with the lid on until the potatoes are soft giving the mixture a little stir every
now and then. If the potatoes are sticking, it’s too hot so turn the heat down and add a little more water
Garnish with fresh coriander.

details.ingredients:
Chicken Mixture For Pastilla - 2.5kg
Frozen Gulash Filo Pastry leaves - Sunbulah - 1kg
Olive Pomace Oil - Freshly - 100ml
details.method:
Turn the oven on to 180*C and adjust a rack in the middle.
Prepare a pie dish and brush the bottoms and sides with extra virgin olive oil.
Take one sheet of phyllo dough and fold it in half vertically . Brush the top of the folded phyllo with extra virgin olive oil. Now lay the folded phyllo
sheet in the middle with the sides hanging on either side of the pan. Repeat with more sheets of the phyllo, making sure each sheet is folded and
brushed with oil. Layer the phyllo sheets in the pan so that they overlap, rotating the pan so that the phyllo will cover it on all sides (there should
be phyllo slack hanging over on all sides of the pan).
Spread the chicken mixture over the phyllo. Cover with the remaining sheets of phyllo, making sure to brush each layer with olive oil. Fold the
phyllo sides over to cove. Brush the top with extra virgin olive oil.
Bake on the center rack of your heated oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the phyllo is fully cooked and golden brown.

details.ingredients:
Extra Virgin Olive Oil - Almarai - 30ml
Salmon, Cut to Portions 120g - 2kg
CAJUN SEASONING - 20g
details.method:
Heat grill to 165*C.
In a medium-sized bowl, add the salmon and Cajun seasoning and oil. Toss well, ensuring each piece is well-coated.
Once the grill is hot, grill the Salmon for 2 to 3 minutes per side, or until cooked

name: Asian Style Braised Beef Short Ribs

details.ingredients:
Garlic, Chopped - 25g
Rosemary, Sanitized - 2g
White Sesame Seeds - Alwafa - 15g
Beef Short Ribs Asian Marination G&G - 1kg
Beef Stock - 1kg
details.method:
Heat the pot, add some oil & add marinated beef ribs & braised it.
Add rosemary & chopped garlic, until fragrant.
Add the beef stock & slow cook the ribs.

details.ingredients:
Onion, White, Diced - 900g
Garlic, Chopped - 3g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 3g
Olive Pomace Oil - Freshly - 45ml
Beef Broth - 1.44kg
Potato, Diced - 453g
Carrots, Sliced - 244g
Celery, Trimmed - 160g
Tomato Paste - Almawasim - 45g
Rosemary, Dried - 5g
Water - 6l
Green Peas - Tomex - 125g
White Flour - Foom - 45g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 2g
Beef Chuck Roll Cubed - 2kg
details.method:
Combine flour, garlic powder and salt & pepper. Toss beef in flour mixture.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven or pot. Cook the beef and onions until browned.
Add beef broth while scraping up any brown bits in the pan.
Stir in all remaining ingredients except for peas, cornstarch and water. Reduce heat to medium low, cover and simmer 1 hour or until beef is
tender (up to 90 minutes).
Mix equal parts cornstarch and water to create a slurry. Slowly add the slurry to the boiling stew to reach desired consistency
Stir in peas and simmer 5-10 minutes before serving . Season with salt & pepper to taste.

details.ingredients:
Browned Meatballs For Albondigas - 1.7kg
Onion, White, Diced - 200g
Whole Peeled Tomatoes in Tomato Juice - 1.5kg
Tomato Paste - Almawasim - 50g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 10g
Parsley, Chopped - 10g
Olive Pomace Oil - Freshly - 50ml
Peppers, Sweet, Green, Sliced - 100g
Carrots, Sliced - 100g
Garlic, Chopped - 8g
Oregano Leaves - Freshly - 5g
Basil Leaves - Freshly - 5g
details.method:
In a skillet, add oil . Sauté the finely chopped onion, bell pepper, and carrot until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and tomato paste. Add the dried oregano, dried basil, salt, and pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the browned meatballs to the skillet, ensuring they are submerged in the sauce. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 20-30
minutes, or until the meatballs are cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper.
Serve the Albóndigas hot, garnished with chopped parsley.

details.ingredients:
Potato, Diced - 100g
Onion, White, Diced - 200g
Tomatoes, Diced - 150g
Peppers, Sweet, Red, Sliced - 100g
Garlic, Chopped - 20g
Paprika Powder - Tamimi Markets - 5g
Oregano Leaves - Freshly - 5g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 10g
Coriander, Chopped - 10g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 40g
Cumin Powder - Alkeif - Hot - 5g
Vegetables Broth - 1kg
Beef Flank Cubed Basic Marination - 1.5kg
details.method:
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and bell peppers to the pot and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Increase the heat to medium-high and add the cubed beef to the pot. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, paprika, and dried oregano. Cook until the
beef is browned on all sides.
Add the diced tomatoes to the pot and cook for a few minutes until they start to break down.
Pour in the vegetable broth, ensuring that the beef is fully submerged. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer,
covered, for about 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Once the beef is tender, add the potatoes to the pot. Continue to simmer, covered, for another 20-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are cooked
through and the sauce has thickened.
Adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper if necessary.
Serve the Carne Con Papa hot, garnished with fresh cilantro.

details.ingredients:
Fried Fish For Fish Escabeche - 2kg
Peppers, Sweet, Green, Julienned - 150g
Onion, White, Sliced - 200g
Carrots, Sliced - 300g
Peppers, Sweet, Red, Julienned - 150g
Water - 100ml
White Sugar - Tamimi Markets - 20g
Soy Sauce - Affco - 40g
Oyster Sauce - Affco - 30g
Tomato Ketchup - Heinz - 60g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 60g
Synthetic White Vinegar - Almawasim - 40g
Garlic & Ginger Paste - 40g
details.method:
In a skillet , add olive oil. Sauté the ginger garlic and onion until softened and fragrant.
Add the carrots and bell peppers to the skillet. Cook until slightly softened but still crisp.
Stir in the vinegar, water, sugar. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Add the fried fish fillets to the skillet, arranging them in a single layer..
Cover the skillet and let the fish simmer in the sauce for about 10-15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the flavors have
infused.
Taste the escabeche and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper.

details.ingredients: Uncooked Quesadillas For Beef Quesadilla s - 500g
details.method:
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium or medium-low heat. Add a touch of oil to the pan for a crispier quesadilla. Cook the quesadillas on one side
until golden, moderating the heat as needed, pressing lightly with a spatula to compress and flatten a bit. Carefully flip the quesadillas with the
spatula and cook on the other side until the tortilla is golden and the filling and cheese is hot and melted.
Cut into triangles and serve immediately.

details.ingredients: Quesadillas For Chicken Quesadillas - 2kg
details.method:
Heat a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium or medium-low heat. Add a touch of oil to the pan for a crispier quesadilla. Cook the quesadillas on
one side until golden, moderating the heat as needed, pressing lightly with a spatula to compress and flatten a bit. Carefully flip the quesadillas
with the spatula and cook on the other side until the tortilla is golden and the filling and cheese is hot and melted.
Cut into triangles and serve immediately.

details.ingredients:
Cooked Chicken for Chicken Zurbian - 3.5kg
Rice for Zurbian - 1.6kg
details.method: on serving dish, place the rice then top it with the chicken

details.ingredients:
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 200g
Honey Soy Chicken Thigh Skewers - 2.23kg
details.method:
Preheat the grill to 165*C
Once the grill is hot, lightly oil the grates to prevent sticking.
Place the chicken Breasts on the grill and cook for about 5-7 minutes on each side or until the chicken is cooked through and has
excellent grill marks.
While grilling, brush the chicken with any remaining marinade to keep them moist and flavorful.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove the chicken from the grill and transfer them to a serving platter.

details.ingredients:
Shrimp (Peeled & Deveined) - Sealand - 453g
Flour Mixture For Crispy Shrimp - 144g
Milk And Egg Mixture For Crispy Shrimp - 154g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 1kg
details.method:
In a deep, wide skillet over medium heat, heat about 3 inches deep of oil.
Working in batches, lightly dredge shrimps in flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip in the egg mixture and then dredge again in flour mixture, patting down flour onto shrimp.
Gently add into hot oil one by one and deep-fry, turning as needed, for about 3 to 5 minutes or until golden and crisp.
Remove from pan and drain on a wire rack set over a baking sheet.

details.ingredients: Harissa Prawns Raw - 1kg
details.method: For grilling by 160*C for up to 8 minutes till well done.

details.ingredients:
Frozen Nile Perch fillet 2000-3000 - 500g
Batter For Lahore Fish - 309g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 500g
details.method:
Pat the fish fillets dry with a paper towel.
In a bowl add the fish and coat it well with the batter. Keep aside for 15 minutes.
Heat oil for deep frying in a big pot. On medium heat, drop the fish fingers in batches. Flip over so that they are equally golden on both sides. When
they are half-way cooked and the coating has stuck to the fish, remove to a paper towel.
Let cool for 15-20 mins while you fry the remaining batch.
Then re-fry the fish fillets for extra crispiness till they are cooked through and are golden brown.

details.ingredients:
Fish Patties - 2kg
Sunflower Oil - Noor - 100ml
details.method:
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the fish cakes for 3 minutes on each side, then hold them on their sides to brown the edges. Transfer
to a baking tray and finish cooking in the oven for 8-10 minutes.

details.ingredients:
Shrimps, Defrosted - 2kg
Olive Pomace Oil - Freshly - 150ml
Garlic, Chopped - 100g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 10g
Red Chili Flakes - 10g
Unsalted Natural Butter - Almarai - 200g
Parsley, Chopped - 100g
Lemon, Juice - 50g
details.method:
In a large skillet or frying pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the olive oil.
Once the butter has melted, add the minced garlic to the skillet. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the garlic is fragrant but not
browned.
Add the shrimp to the skillet in a single layer. Season with salt, pepper and red pepper flakes. Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the
shrimp turn pink and opaque.
Once the shrimp are cooked through, add the chopped parsley and lemon juice to the skillet. Stir well to combine and coat the shrimp with the
garlic butter sauce.
Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning with salt, pepper, or more lemon juice if necessary.
Serve the Camarones Al Ajillo hot.

name: Sour Cream And Chives Mashed Potato

details.ingredients:
FROZEN LAMB DUMPLING - 1kg
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 10g
details.method:
Heat corn oil in a pot on medium heat. It should take 5-10 minutes until it gets hot.
Gently add the manto in the oil and fry for one minute or until desired golden brown. The manto will float to the top of the oil so you will need to
push it down for an even fry. After frying, place it on a paper towel to soak up the oil.

details.ingredients:
Chinese Buns/ Steamed - 1kg
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 1.5kg
details.method:
Heat corn oil in a pot on medium heat. It should take 5-10 minutes until it gets hot.
Gently add the mantou in the oil and fry for one minute or until desired golden brown. The mantou will float to the top of the oil so you will need to
push it down for an even fry. After frying, place it on a paper towel to soak up the oil.

details.ingredients:
Cheese, Akawi - 400g
Olive Pomace Oil - Freshly - 60ml
Puff Pastry Sheets - Sunbulah - 500g
details.method:
Preheat Oven to 180*C.
Place a samosa sheet on a clean flat work surface and place the Cheese filling on one end and fold samosa to form a triangle. Repeat
with remaining filling and pastry.
Once samosa is folded. Place them on an oiled baking tray, brush the top of the samosa with more oil using a pastry brush. Bake samosa
in preheated oven for 10 minutes, flip them over and bake for another 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown.

details.ingredients:
Soaked Chinese Flower Mushroom - 300g
Ginger, Chopped - 50g
Garlic, Chopped - 30g
Soy Sauce - Kikkoman - 120g
White Pepper powder - Naseel - 5g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 60g
Onions, Spring, Trimmed - 100g
Soy Sauce - Affco - 60g
White Sugar - Tamimi Markets - 30g
Water, Tap - 1l
Corn Starch - Mefsco - 30g
Sesame Oil - Lulu - 30ml
details.method:
Heat vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the thinly sliced ginger and minced garlic. Sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped scallions to the pot. Cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Drain the soaked mushrooms and add them to the pot.
Stir in soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and sugar.
Pour in enough water to cover the mushrooms.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low.
Cover the pot and let it simmer for about 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the mushrooms are tender. Stir occasionally and add more water to keep the
mushrooms submerged.
In a small bowl, dissolve cornstarch in water to create a slurry.
Stir the cornstarch slurry into the simmering mushroom mixture.
Cook for another 5-10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Stir in sesame oil and white pepper.
Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more soy sauce or sugar according to your preference.
Transfer the braised Chinese flower mushrooms to a serving dish.

details.ingredients:
Potato, Sanitized - 1.2kg
Chicken Broth - 375g
Olive Pomace Oil - Freshly - 125ml
Lemon, Juice - 85g
Garlic, Chopped - 35g
Oregano Leaves - Freshly - 15g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
details.method:
Preheat oven to 180*C.
Peel potatoes and cut large ones into thick wedges and medium ones into 3.
Place potatoes in a roasting pan with all the other ingredients. Toss well.
Roast for 20 minutes. Turn potatoes, roast for a further 25 to 30 minutes until the liquid is mostly absorbed by potatoes/evaporated and left with
mainly oil in the pan.
Transfer potatoes to a separate tray. Tilt the original roasting pan and scoop off as much of the oil as you can , then drizzle over the potatoes.
Transfer potatoes to oven and roast for 35 – 40 minutes, turning once or twice, until potatoes are golden and a bit crispy on the edges.
Return pan with the garlic juices to the oven for the last 5 – 10 minutes or so to reduce down and make the garlic golden.
Transfer potatoes to serving platter. Drizzle over the reduced garlic pan juices.
Garnished with lemon wedges and oregano.

details.ingredients:
Potato, Sanitized - 1.47kg
Cheese, Cheddar, Shredded - 170g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 5g
Onions, Spring, Chopped - 30g
Unsalted Natural Butter - Almarai - 58g
Sour Cream - Nada - 61g
Chives, Chopped - 11g
Beef, Bacon, Defrosted - 168g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 5g
details.method:
Preheat oven to 180*C. Prick potatoes all over with a fork or sharp knife and wrap tightly in foil. Bake until soft, about 1 hour.
Unwrap potatoes and cut lengthwise slits in the top of each. Carefully scoop out flesh from center of each potato into a medium bowl, then add
butter, sour cream, chives, green onion whites, half the cheddar, and half the bacon. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon filling back into each potato, mounding it on top. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and return to oven until melted, about 5 minutes. Top with
scallion greens and remaining bacon.

details.ingredients:
Sauce For Honey Garlic Potato - 335g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 30g
Garlic, Chopped - 28g
Unsalted Natural Butter - Almarai - 30g
Potatoes, Baby, Halved - 681g
Toast Sesame Seeds - 10g
details.method:
Heat the oil over medium high heat in a pot or pan. Add in the potatoes, and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the potatoes have turned golden brown,
stirring occasionally.
Toss in the garlic, and continue to sauté with the potatoes until the garlic is golden and fragrant, about 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the prepared sauce from earlier. Bring the potatoes to a boil, then let simmer for 7-8 minutes with a lid on until the potatoes are fork
tender.
Remove the lid and continue to reduce/boil the sauce for another 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened into a sticky glaze. Add in the
unsalted butter and stir until melted and smooth.
Serve and top with toasted sesame seeds.

details.ingredients:
Boiled Potato - 907g
Cream Mixture For Chive Potato Puree - 283g
Chives, Chopped - 30g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 2g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 2g
details.method:
Mash the boiled potato with a potato masher to desired consistency. Add cream mixture, salt, and pepper, stirring until well combined. Stir in
chopped fresh chives.

details.ingredients:
Olive Pomace Oil - Freshly - 48ml
Carrots, Strips - 900g
Parsnips, Trimmed - 900g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 5g
Salted Natural Butter - 30g
Thyme, Chopped - 15g
Honey - Wadi Al Nahil - 45g
details.method:
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the carrots, parsnips, salt and pepper and toss to coat. Cook, gently tossing
occasionally, until the carrots and parsnips are tender and golden in spots, 15 to 20 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and add the butter, thyme and honey. Toss until the butter is melted and the vegetables are well coated, 2 to 4 minutes.
Transfer to a serving platter, drizzle with the remaining honey and top with thyme.

name: Artichoke with Herb Crust & Tomato Fondue
Grilled Barramundi Fillet on Puttanesca Potato

details.ingredients:
Bok Choy, Cut in pcs - 2kg
Garlic, Chopped - 200g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 100g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 10g
Soy Sauce - Affco - 50g
details.method:
Cut the bok choy into halves or quarters, depending on the size, to ensure even cooking.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and sauté for about 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the bok choy to the skillet.
Stir-fry the bok choy for 3-5 minutes, or until it is tender-crisp and the leaves are wilted. Season the garlic bok choy with salt, pepper, and soy
sauce to taste. Be cautious with the soy sauce as it can make the dish too salty if added in excess.
Once cooked, transfer the garlic bok choy to a serving dish.

details.ingredients:
White Flour - Foom - 200g
Eggs - Saeed Co. Farmer - 240g
Unsalted Natural Butter - Almarai - 100g
Breadcrumbs Mixture For Panko Butter Fish Fillet - 570g
Lemon, Sliced - 40g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 10g
Nile Perch, Sliced 120g - 1.5kg
details.method:
Preheat your oven to 180*C. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place all-purpose flour in shallow dish, and the beaten eggs in another shallow dish.
Season the nile perch with salt and pepper.
Dredge each butterfish fillet in all-purpose flour, shaking off any excess.
Dip the floured fillets into the beaten eggs, allowing any excess to drip off.
Coat the fillets in the panko breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere the breadcrumbs to the fish.
Place the breaded butterfish fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the melted butter evenly over the fillets.
Bake the butterfish fillets in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the breadcrumbs are golden brown and the fish is cooked
through.
Garnished with lemon slices.

details.ingredients:
Broccoli, Fleurette - 2kg
Cheese, Parmesan, Grated - 200g
Olive Pomace Oil - Freshly - 100ml
Garlic, Chopped - 50g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 10g
Lemon, Cut into Wedges - 20g
details.method:
Preheat your oven to 180*C
In a large mixing bowl, combine the broccoli florets, grated Parmesan cheese, olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Toss until the broccoli is
evenly coated with the cheese and seasonings.
Spread the broccoli mixture out in a single layer on a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper or aluminum foil.
Roast the broccoli in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the edges are crispy and the broccoli is tender when pierced with a fork.
Once cooked, remove the broccoli from the oven and transfer it to a serving dish.
Garnish with lemon wedges.

details.ingredients:
Marinated Duck For Duck A L'Orange - 6kg
Sauce For Duck A L'Orange - 800g
details.method:
Preheat your oven to 180°C.
Once marinated, place the ducks in the preheated oven and roast for about 2 to 2.5 hours, or until the skin is crispy and golden brown, and the
internal temperature reaches 74°C (165°F) when measured with a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh.
Once cooked, remove the ducks from the oven and let them rest for about 15 minutes before carving.
Carve the roasted ducks into serving portions and arrange them on a serving platter.
Drizzle the warm sauce over the duck portions just before serving.

name: Fillet Of Salmon With Dill Crust

details.ingredients:
Salmon, Cut to Portions 120g - 2kg
Olive Pomace Oil - Freshly - 100ml
Lemon, Zest - 5g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 10g
Lemon, Cut into Wedges - 10g
Dill, Chopped - 10g
Dill-Breadcrumbs Mixture For Fillet Of Salmon Dill Crust - 400g
Dijon Mustard - Fresh Avenue - 100g
details.method:
Preheat your oven to 180*C.
Place the salmon fillet on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread a thin layer of Dijon mustard evenly over the top of the salmon fillet.
Press the dill breadcrumb mixture onto the top of the salmon fillet, coating it evenly.
Bake the salmon fillet in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the salmon is cooked through.
Once cooked, remove the salmon from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes.
Garnished with lemon wedges and fresh dill.

name: Peruvian Chicken With Creamy Green Sauce

details.ingredients:
Lamb, Leg, Boneless, Diced - 1kg
Carrots, Cube - 200g
Potato, Cube - 300g
Onions, Spring, Sliced - 50g
Garlic, Chopped - 50g
Bay Leaves - Muntazah Food Industries - 2g
Parsley, Chopped - 15g
Salt/Black Pepper - 15g
Lamb Broth - 1kg
Whole Silver Onion - Orient Gardens - 150g
details.method:
Place the lamb meat into a large saucepan and cover with cold water.
Bring slowly to the boil, skim off any scum, then immediately drain into a colander and rinse in cold running water. This scalding
removes fat.
Return the meat to the pan and cover with the stock and bring to the boil.
Turn down the heat and simmer partially, until tender.
Add the carrots, baby onions, garlic and bay leaf to the stock and cook for another 15 minutes.
Then add the potatoes and cook for another 10-15 minutes, or until the potato starts to dissolve into the soup and thickens it &
the carrots are tender.
Finally check the seasoning, adding the black pepper and salt to taste.
Garnish with the spring onions and chopped parsley.

details.ingredients:
Charred Broccoli For Charred Broccoli With almond Sauce - 660g
Almond Butter Sauce - 100g
Poppy Seeds - 10g
details.method:
Place broccoli on a large serving platter. Drizzle with some almond sauce and scatter with poppy seeds. Serve with remaining almond sauce
alongside.

name: Celeriac Cordon Blue with Almond Veloute

details.ingredients:
Lamb Rack Standard - Oakley Park - 2kg
Herb Crust Mixture For Herb Crusted Rack Of Lamb - 600g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 5g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 5g
details.method:
Preheat your oven to 180*C.
Trim any excess fat from the racks of lamb and season with salt and black pepper.
Generously coat each rack of lamb with the herb crust mixture, pressing it onto the meat to adhere.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the racks of lamb, fat side down first, for about 3-4 minutes per side until browned.
Transfer the skillet with the racks of lamb to the preheated oven.
Roast for 15-20 minutes for medium-rare doneness.
Remove the racks of lamb from the oven and let them rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Slice the racks into individual chops and arrange on a serving platter.

details.ingredients:
Fried Chicken Thighs For Creole Chicken - 1.2kg
Onion, White, Diced - 150g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 10g
Creole Seasoning - 18g

Add chopped onion and sauté for about 5-7 minutes until translucent.
Add minced garlic and sauté for another minute until fragrant.
Add cauliflower florets to the pot and stir to combine with the onions and garlic.
Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in vegetable broth and add bay leaves and thyme.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the cauliflower is tender.
Pour the blended cashew mixture into the pot with the soup.
Stir well to combine and simmer for an additional 5 minutes to heat through and meld flavors.
Stir in fresh lemon juice to brighten the flavors.

In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.

To serve, ladle the borscht into bowls and top each serving with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of fresh dill.

Heat the spice paste in a wok over medium heat and gradually stir in the coconut milk.
Add the turmeric powder, lime leaves and lemongrass, mix well and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, simmer uncovered for 2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent curdling.
Add the beef chunks and continue to simmer uncovered until the beef is tender, and the sauce has almost dried up, which should take 1 to
1 ½ hours.
Add some water if the sauce has dried up before the beef is cooked.
Finally reduce heat to very low and stir-fry the beef chunks until they brown in the oil from the coconut milk, taking care not to scorch the
beef. Remove from the heat, discard the lime leaves if desired, and serve.

Once the water is boiling, carefully add the sweet potato chunks or slices to the pot.
Let the sweet potatoes blanch in the boiling water for about 5-7 minutes, or until they are just tender.
Once blanched, remove the sweet potatoes from the boiling water and immediately transfer them to a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking
process.
Let the sweet potatoes cool in the ice water for a few minutes, then drain them thoroughly.
Once drained, the sweet potatoes are ready to be use.

details.ingredients:

details.method:

Wash the potatoes thoroughly and pat them dry with a clean kitchen towel.
Place a potato between the handles of two wooden spoons or chopsticks to act as a guide to prevent cutting all the way through the potato.
Using a sharp knife, make thin slices across each potato, spacing them about 1/8 to 1/4 inch apart, but not cutting all the way through. The
wooden spoons or chopsticks will stop the knife from cutting all the way through the potato.
Place the sliced potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or aluminum foil.
Brush the butter mixture over the potatoes, making sure to get in between the slices.
Bake the potatoes in the preheated oven for 50-60 minutes, or until they are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the edges are
golden brown.
Once cooked, remove the potatoes from the oven and transfer them to a serving dish.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley.

to ensure even browning.

Spread each piece of the dough into a circle about 9 inches in diameter. Then roll 2 opposite sides of the circle towards the center so it ends up
have a boat like shape. Then pinch the corners together.
Transfer the khachapuri onto a baking sheet lined with greased parchment paper.
Stuff each khachapuri with the cheese mixture. Then brush the dough with egg wash.
Bake in a preheated oven for about 15 minutes or until the crust becomes golden brown.
Make a well in the center of each khachapuri with the back of a spoon and drop egg into each well. Then stick a few small pieces of butter into the
cheese.
Return the khachapuri back into the oven and bake for another 5-6 minutes. Cooking time may vary depending on your oven. The egg white should
be white but still pretty runny. It will cook further as it sits in the hot cheese. When serving, mix the cheese and egg with a fork and serve
immediately.

details.ingredients:

details.method:
Preheat oven to 170*C. Line the base of a springform with baking paper, grease the sides, and dust with a little flour.
Melt chocolate over boiling water. Let cool slightly. Slit vanilla pod lengthwise and scrape out seeds.
Using a hand mixer with whisks, beat the softened butter with the icing sugar and vanilla seeds until bubbles appear.
Separate the eggs. Whisk the egg yolks into the butter mixture one by one. Now gradually add melted chocolate.
Beat the egg whites with the castor sugar until stiff, then place on top of the butter and chocolate mixture.
Sift the flour over the mixture, then fold in the flour and beaten egg whites.
Transfer the mixture to the springform, smooth the top, and bake in the oven (middle rack) for 10-15 minutes, leaving the oven door a
finger's width ajar.
Then close the oven and bake for approximately 50 minutes. (The cake is done when it yields slightly to the touch.)
Remove the cake from the oven and loosen the sides of the springform.
Carefully tip the cake onto a cake rack lined with baking paper and let cool for approximately 20 minutes.
Then pull off the baking paper, turn the cake over, and leave on rack to cool completely.
Cut the cake in half horizontally. Warm the jam and stir until smooth.
Brush the top of both cake halves with the jam and place one on top of the other. Brush the sides with the jam as well.
To make the glaze, put the castor sugar into a saucepan withl water and boil over high heat for approximately 5 minutes.
Take the sugar syrup off the stove and leave to cool a little.
Coarsely chop the chocolate, gradually adding it to the syrup, and stir until it forms a thick liquid.

details.method:
Preheat oven to 160*C Grease two 9-inch cake pans, line with parchment paper rounds, then grease the parchment paper. Parchment
paper helps the cakes seamlessly release from the pans.
Make the cake: Whisk the flour, baking soda, cocoa powder, and salt together in a large bowl. Set aside.
Using a handheld or stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat the butter and sugar together on medium-high speed until
combined, about 1 minute. Scrape down the sides and up the bottom of the bowl with a rubber spatula as needed. Add the oil, egg yolks,
vanilla extract, and vinegar and beat on high for 2 minutes. (Set the egg whites aside.) Scrape down the sides and up the bottom of the
bowl with a spatula as needed.
With the mixer on low speed, add the dry ingredients in 2-3 additions alternating with the buttermilk. Beat in your desired amount of food
coloring just until combined. I use gel food coloring. Vigorously whisk or beat the 4 egg whites on high speed until fluffy peaks form
about 3 minutes. Gently fold into cake batter. The batter will be silky and slightly thick.
Divide batter between cake pans. Bake for 30-32 minutes or until the tops of the cakes spring back when gently touched and a toothpick
inserted in the center comes out clean. If the cakes need a little longer as determined by wet crumbs on the toothpick, bake for longer.
However, careful not to overbake as the cakes may dry out. Remove cakes from the oven and cool completely in the pans set on a wire
rack. The cakes must be completely cool before frosting and assembling
Using a large serrated knife, slice a thin layer off the tops of the cakes to create a flat surface. Discard or crumble over finished cake.
Place 1 cake layer on your cake stand or serving plate. Evenly cover the top with frosting. Top with 2nd layer and spread remaining
frosting all over the top and sides. I always use an icing spatula and bench scraper for the frosting.

details.method:

In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a large mixing bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Beat the butter on medium speed until creamy.
Add the sugar and lemon zest and beat until light and fluffy, about 5 minutes. Add the vanilla then eggs one at a time, scrape down the
bowl between additions, and beat until well combined and fluffy.
Stir the buttermilk and lemon juice together.
With the mixer on low speed, add a third of the flour mixture followed by half of the milk mixture. Continue, alternating between the flour
and milk, mixing just until combined. Stop and scrape down the bowl occasionally. Divide the batter among the prepared cake pans.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until the center of the cakes are springy to the touch and the sides are just starting to pull away from the
pan. Let the cakes cool in the pan for 15 minutes then invert and cool completely on a wire rack. Add the lemon zest To the butter cream
cheese and beat until light and fluffy,
frosting, spreading smoothly out to the edges. Top with the second cake layer and spread the remaining frosting all over the outside of
the cake. Decorate with thin lemon slices or edible flowers, if desired.

then stir in half the milk.

Pour the batter into the greased idli molds, filling each mold about three-quarters full.
Arrange the filled molds in a steamer.
Steam the idlis for about 10-12 minutes on medium-high heat. If you are using a pressure cooker, do it without the whistle (weight).
Checking for Doneness:
To check if the idlis are done, insert a toothpick or a knife into one idli. It should come out clean.
Cooling:
Let the idlis cool for a few minutes before removing them from the molds. Use a spoon to gently scoop them out.

details.ingredients:

details.method:
Preheat the oven to 160*C. Lightly grease a 9 inches loaf pan.
Line the pan with parchment paper, then lightly grease the paper. Set the pan aside.
Mix the flour, baking powder and baking soda, together in a bowl. Set aside.
Whisk the date, honey, water, and coffee together and set aside.
In the bowl of an electric mixer set at medium speed, beat the butter, and sugar for 2-3 minutes add eggs 1 by 1 then well blend. Stir in
the honey mixture and blend it in thoroughly. Add the flour mixture and blend it in thoroughly. Spoon the batter into the prepared pan.
Bake for 60-70 minutes or until a cake tester inserted into the center comes out clean. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes then invert onto a
cake rack to cool completely. Frosting with butter cream cheese.

details.ingredients:

details.method:

In a bowl combine flour, baking soda, and vanilla
then in a mixing bowl add egg and sugar whisk it until it fluffy
and add the flour, baking soda and vanilla and the butter mixture

then keep inside the chiller for 1 hour then remove cover with the mousse Freeze overnight. then cover with raspberry mirror glaze

details.method:
Preheat your oven to 180*C.
Arrange the polenta fries in a single layer on a greased baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 30-35 minutes, flipping halfway through cooking, or until the fries are golden brown and crispy on the
outside.
Once done, remove the polenta fries from the oven and let them cool slightly before serving.

hazelnut butter cream top of the roll sur face also and garnish with roasted hazelnut and put it in the fridge.

name: Grind Urad Dal for Medu Vada

details.ingredients: Soaked Dal for Medu Vada - 1kg
details.method:
Drain the soaked urad dal.
Grind the dal into a smooth, fluffy batter using a wet grinder or a powerful blender. Add water as needed to achieve a thick, smooth consistency.
The batter should not be too runny.
Transfer the batter to a large mixing bowl.

details.ingredients:
Coconut Pecan Frosting for German chocolate cake - 1kg
Dark Chocolate Chips - Beryl's - 115g
Water - 120ml
White Flour for Bread Production - MC4 - 270g
Cocoa Powder - Reihan - 15g
Baking Soda - Orient Gardens - 5g
Baking Powder - Orient Gardens - 3g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 3g
Unsalted Natural Butter - Almarai - 284g
White Sugar - Tamimi Markets - 400g
Eggs - Saeed Co. Farmer - 4g
Vanilla Culinary Essence - Foster Clarks - 8ml
Fresh Laban (Full Fat) - Almarai - 240ml
details.method:
Preheat the oven to 160*C Butter and flour three (8-inch) round cake pans or lightly grease with baking spray. Line the bottoms with
parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the chocolate and hot water. Microwave on high in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until melted and
combined. Or melt in a double boiler over hot water, stirring until combined. Set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
In a large mixing bowl, using a hand mixer or stand mixer with the paddle attachment, beat the butter and sugar on medium speed until
light and fluffy, 3 to 5 minutes. Stop and scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed.
Add the egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Then, beat in the vanilla extract. Add the melted chocolate mixture and
beat until incorporated.
With the mixer on low speed, add a third of the flour mixture followed by half of the buttermilk. Repeat with another third of the flour, the
rest of the buttermilk, and the final third of the flour. Beat only until the ingredients are mixed together, and stop occasionally to scrape
down the bowl.
In a separate bowl with clean beaters, beat the egg whites on high speed until thick and frothy. Slowly sprinkle in the remaining cup of
sugar. Beat until stiff peaks form, then gently fold the egg whites into the batter.
Divide the batter evenly among the prepared pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for about 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the tops spring back when lightly
pressed. Let the cakes cool in the pans on a wire rack for about 15 minutes. Then, carefully invert the layers onto the wire racks, remove
the parchment paper, and cool completely.
Assembly:
Place a cooled cake layer on a cake stand and top with a third of the frosting. Spread the frosting just over the edge of the cake. Place
another cake layer on top and repeat with another third of the frosting. Finish with t...

details.ingredients:
Dough For Garlic Naan - 4.22kg
Garlic Butter for Naan - 525g
Black Seed - Tamimi Markets - 200g
details.method:
Sprinkle flour on the dough and place it on a lightly dusted rolling board. Avoid adding too much of the flour when rolling. Use sparingly and as
needed.
Sprinkle nigella seeds or sesame seeds on the dough. Roll the dough out into a round or oval shape with a rolling pin.
You could pull the top part of the rolled dough with your fingers to make a tapering dough.
Turn the rolled dough gently and let the side with the nigella seeds touch the rolling board's surface. Spread water all over the top side.
Next, heat a tawa or a flat skillet. Keep the heat to medium-high or high.
Place the watered side touching the hot skillet or tawa.
Cook for 1 to 2 minutes or until you see the base nicely browned and charred.
Using a spatula, separate the naan from the skillet.
Lift the naan with tongs and place it on a direct flame with the side that is not cooked touching the flame.
Move the naan all over the flame to ensure the sides and the surfaces are well cooked with some chars.
Brush the garlic butter on a tray or plate and spread some garlic and mint/cilantro (from the garlic butter) all over the naan.

details.ingredients:

details.method:
Combine garlic, ginger, oil and salt in a blender.
Puree, adding water as needed to get the mixture to blend thoroughly.
Store in the fridge. Discard when the flavors fade.

line the bottom of a trifle bowl with half (approximately 3 cups) of your cake slices. Drizzle cake slices.

some of the custard.

the remaining jelly squares.

Add whipped cream on top.

name: Flank Steak with Olive Oil and Herbs Rub

firmly and evenly onto all sides.

details.method:
Heat the olive oil in a large pan and when it starts shimmering add the tomato.
Cook over medium heat until soft and translucent, it will take 5-6 minutes.
Add the cooked fettuccine pasta to the pan add the cherry tomato to the napolitana sauce and toss until well combined.
Freshly ground black pepper and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil

To a large bowl, add the romaine lettuce and drizzle some tahini dressing. Toss to coat, then add tomatoes, cucumber, onions,
chickpeas, and the crushed falafel. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and drizzle more with tahini dressing.

details.ingredients:

details.method:
Put frozen or fresh berries in shot glasses. Pour raspberry jelly over, then refrigerate
Bloom the gelatin in cold water.
Place a saucepan on medium heat, and melt the gelatine, once melted, add some of the creme anglaise into
the melted gelatine, mix well, then combine all the rest of the creme anglaise.
Whisk the cream until it reaches soft peaks. Gently fold the cream into the cream anglaise. Put the mousse
on top of the jelly.
Put the sauteed apples on top of the vanilla mousse
and cover with the crumbs

details.ingredients:
Yeast Mixture for Chinese Bun - 440g
White Flour for Bread Production - MC4 - 700g
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 5g
details.method:
Combine the all-purpose flour and salt in a separate large mixing bowl.
Make a well in the center of the flour mixture.
Gradually pour the yeast mixture into the well of the flour mixture, stirring continuously with a wooden spoon or spatula until a shaggy dough
forms.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead it for about 8-10 minutes or until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Add more flour if necessary to prevent sticking.
Place the kneaded dough in a lightly greased bowl, cover it with a clean kitchen towel or plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1-1.5
hours or until doubled in size.

details.ingredients:
Apple Pie Filling for classic apple pie - 4kg
Short Crust Dough G&G - 1kg
details.method:
Preheat oven to 160*C.
On a lightly floured surface, roll half of the pie dough into circle.
Transfer dough to a metal pie tray.
Place crust in the freezer for 30 minutes or up to 24 hours.
When ready to bake, place a rimmed baking sheet on the middle oven rack.
Roll out the remaining dough on a lightly floured surface.
Remove pie crust from freezer and add the cooled filling in an even layer.
Cover apples with remaining dough.
Press the edges together, trim the excess dough, and crimp the edges with your fingers or a press down with the tines of a fork.
(Using a fork might be easier if the bottom crust is too cold to crimp.)
Place pie on the hot sheet pan and bake for 20 minutes.
Reduce heat and bake for another 30 to 40 minutes, until the filling bubbles in the steam vents, and the crust is golden brown.

details.ingredients:
Sugar Syrup - 500ml
egg yolks - 180g
White Sugar - Tamimi Markets - 250g
Whipping Cream - Alrai - 750ml
Mascarpone Cheese - Galbani - 1kg
Lemon, Zest - 50g
Lemon, Juice - 50g
Savoiardi Ladyfingers - Marini - 1kg
Vanilla Culinary Essence - Foster Clarks - 10ml
details.method:
Place egg yolks and sugar in a bowl and set over pot with water.
Make sure the bottom of the bowl does not touch the water.
Start whisking constantly, until the sugar is dissolved, and the custard thickens.
Remove the bowl from heat and let cool.
When slightly chilled add mascarpone cheese and beat until combined and smooth.
Add lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla extract and mix until combined and smooth.
In a separate bowl whip cold whipped cream to stiff peaks. Fold 1/3 of the whipped cream into the mascarpone mixture. Then fold the
remaining whipped cream. Set aside.
In a shallow bowl mix lemon juice, sugar syrup and set aside.
Dip each ladyfinger into the lemon mixture for 1-2 seconds.
Arrange soaked ladyfingers in the bottom of a medium sized dish. If needed, break a few ladyfingers to fit them in the dish. Spread half
of the cream over the soaked ladyfingers.
Repeat with another layer of ladyfingers and spread the remaining cream on top.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight.
Grated with some lemon zest.

details.ingredients:
Citrus Dressing - 200g
Soaked Rice Noodles - 300g
Peppers, Sweet, Red, Diced - 50g
Cucumber, Diced - 20g
Onions, Spring, Sliced - 20g

Garlic, Chopped - 15g
Sliced Green Jalape o - Peep - 20g

details.method:
In a bowl, add the olive oil to the soaked rice noodles.
Mix romaine lettuce, red bell pepper, red onion, green onions, cucumber, basil, cilantro, ginger root, jalapeno pepper, and garlic with rice
noodles.
Pour over the rice noodle mixture with the citrus dressing and toss to coat.

details.ingredients:
Chocolate Sponge - 1kg
Cream Cheese Spread - Philadelphia - 500g
White Sugar - Tamimi Markets - 200g
Whipped Cream - 200g
Original Biscuit - Oreo - 500g
Chocolate Ganache - 800g
details.method:
Once cakes are completely cooled, prepare the filling by beating the cream cheese and sugar together with a hand mixer until well
blended.
Fold in the cool whip until almost blended then fold in the coarsely crushed Oreo cookies.
With a serrated knife, cut off the domed top of each of the rounds to make the cake even and level. Save the parts you cut off for another
use.
Place one round on your serving platter or cake plate.
Top with half of the cream cheese filling mixture and spread evenly.
Top with the other cake round. Now use the filling to fill in the center filling section of the cake so that the filling layer is completely even
with the cake layers.
Then cover the top and sides of the cake with the chocolate ganache.

details.ingredients:
Chocolate Sponge - 1kg
Maple Frosting for Chocolate Maple Cake - 420g
White Chocolate - Make-Up - 5g
details.method:
Place the first cake on a plate, then top with a scoop of frosting and spread evenly. Top with the second layer and frost again (repeat if
doing three layers). Finish by frosting the outside of the cake with the remaining frosting Keep inside chiller

details.ingredients:
White chocolate sponge for Chocolate Dame Blanche - 1kg
White Chocolate Swiss Meringue Buttercream: - 1kg
White Chocolate Ganache - 500g
details.method:
Place one layer of cake on a cake stand or serving plate. Top with 1 cup of buttercream and spread evenly. Repeat with remaining layers
and crumb coat the cake. Chill for 20mins.
Frost and smooth the sides with the remaining frosting. Use a scalloped cake comb to create the textured effect on the sides. Smooth
the
top. Chill for 30mins until frosting is cold and firm.
Using a small spoon, place dollops of ganache around the top edges of the chilled cake, allowing some to drip down. Fill in the top of the
cake with more ganache and spread evenly with an offset spatula. Chill to set ganache (5 mins).
Pipe dollops of buttercream on top using an Ateco or Wilton 1M tip, top each with a Lindt White Chocolate Truffle if desired. Sprinkle
chocolate shavings along the bottom and to fill in the top.

details.ingredients:
Chocolate Sponge - 1kg
Chocolate Buttercream Frosting for Chocolate Cake - 1kg
details.method:
Place a cooled cake layer on a cake stand. Top with frosting and spread it out the edges in an even layer. Place the remaining cake layer
on top and spread the rest of the frosting all over the outside of the cake. You can reserve some of the frosting to pipe decorations if
desired.

details.ingredients:
Chicken for Maklouba (Maqluba) - 2.6kg
Veggies for Chicken Maklouba - 2kg
Chicken Broth - 1.44kg
Jasmine Fragrant Rice - Lulu - 600g
Tomatoes, Sliced - 500g
details.method:
Wash the rice a few times to make sure the starches are removed. Soak in cold water for about 30 minutes.
Once soaked, strain and add the 7 spices, maqluba spices, and salt. Mix well and set aside.
For assembly, my hack is to cut parchment paper the same size as the bottom of the pot you're using and lay it flat.
Add tomato slices, then layer the chicken on top. Add the vegetables and finally the rice.
Now once your maqluba is assembled, make sure to add HOT broth. You don't want this to be warm or cold.
Let it boil on medium-high heat, then cover and lower the heat until the rice is fully cooked, anywhere from 15-25 minutes. The rice on top should
be fluffy and cooked.

details.ingredients:

details.method:
Slice the small French baguettes in half lengthwise and toast them, if desired. Spread a thin layer of the sriracha mayo on each half of bread. Slice
the chicken and place on top. Spoon any leftover sauce (or maggi sauce) on top of the chicken. Drain the veggies and add a big handful to each
sandwich. Top with a small handful of fresh cilantro leaves. Sandwich with the top half of the roll and enjoy!

name: Chicken And Vegetable Mixture For Braised Chicken With Mushroom & Root Vegetable

details.ingredients:
Creme Anglaise - 100g

Abed Gelatine - Bakemate - 4g
Water, Tap - 40ml
details.method:
Soak the gelatine in a bowl of water for a few minutes until it softens.
Squeeze out excess water and put aside.
Puree the cherries compote in a blender and then push through a fine sieve until you have removed all the skin/pulp.
Heat half of the puree in a pan on medium heat with the sugar until dissolved, then whisk in the gelatine. Stir this mix into the rest of the pureed
cherries compote and put aside to cool.
Add the creme anglaise and whipped cream fold it well and keep it aside.

details.ingredients:
Pistachio Sponge for Cherry & Pistachio - 500g
Cherry Mirror Glaze - 500g
Pistachio Mousse - 200g
Cherry Mousse - 300g
details.method:
METHOD
Place the pistachio sponge on a cake board, and pop your cake ring around it loosely and then tighten the cake ring around the sponge
so it s snug.
Pour your cherry mousse over the base and make sure it s spread evenly with a palette knife. Cover and pop in the fridge for minimum
1hr to set.
Remove from the fridge and pour the pistachio mousse and add a layer of cherry mousse over the pistachio mouse layer, again
spreading evenly with a palette knife. Cover and pop in the freezer for 1.5hrs.
Then cover the top of the cake and freeze for min 6 hours.
Bring the cherry mirror glaze up to room temperature and pour over the mousse cake (make sure it s definitely cool as anything warmer
will melt the mousse!).
Pop back in the fridge for minimum 1-2hrs.
Decorate with chopped pistachios.

name: Caramel Pineapple with Lime & Coconut Cream

details.ingredients:
Hazelnut Base for Caramel and Coffee Cake - 100g
Caramel Mousse for caramel and coffee cake - 550g
Caramel Glaze for caramel and coffee cake - 600g
Chocolate Ganache - 165g
details.method:
Prepare the 9 inch Ring pan bottom side cover with foil
Pour a third of the mousse into the ring pan and tap it on the table to straighten the top
Let the ganache cool to room temperature until it s pretty thick, then transfer to a piping bag with a round tip. Place the cut sable layers,
crust side facing down, into two rings. Then, pipe the ganache on them in a circular motion and straighten with a small spatula, making
sure it covers the sable completely and is nicely leveled. Refrigerate for 2 hours minimum, chocolate side facing down. Carefully insert
one of your hazelnut bases right in the middle.
Insert the upper part of your ring pan and make sure it s secure in its place.
Add the rest of the mousse on top of that (I use a piping bag at this point), but reserve some to fill in the sides and top. Place the second
hazelnut base chocolate side down on the top and pipe the remaining mousse around the edges. Use a small spatula to secure the
cream on top. Freeze overnight.

details.ingredients:

Sauce Mixture For Teriyaki Beef - 318g

Garlic, Chopped - 21g
Ginger, Chopped - 15g
details.method:
Heat oil in a skillet to medium high heat.
Add the green onions, garlic and ginger and cook being careful not to burn for about 1-2 minutes. Add the sauce mixture and stir to
combine. Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 4-5 minutes until it thickens. Add the beef and serve immediately.

details.ingredients:

Add the fried kafta meatballs, tomato paste, Egyptian rice, and diced potato.
Cook until the Egyptian rice and the diced potato are done.

details.ingredients:

details.method:
Butter and sugar together. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Mix in vanilla. Stir in flour, baking powder and salt gently. Add milk if
needed.
Divide batter into 2 equal parts. Add food coloring to 1 part to make a deep pink color. Grease two 7 inch square pans. Spread batters

details.ingredients:

Mix well the milk, yogurt, and ghee together. then add the sugar. Then add semolina, and coconut. Then combine all together and pour in
one baking sheet and sprinkle with chopped almond on top. Bake for 40 minutes.
Once you remove from the oven pour sugar syrup at room temperature, chill then cut.
Garnish with almonds.

details.ingredients:

Place the bananas in a bowl. Sprinkle with white flour, brown sugar and ground cinnamon, then pour over fresh lemon juice.
Toss, then spread out evenly in a baking dish. crumble
Spread over the bananas, crumbling with fingers if required to get that crumbly topping.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. Remove, cover loosely with foil to keep warm and let stand for 10 minutes before

details.ingredients:

Fresh Laban (Full Fat) - Almarai - 168ml
Sour Cream - Nada - 81g
Eggs - Saeed Co. Farmer - 180g
Banana, Yellow, Sanitized - 300g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 64g
Vanilla Culinary Essence - Foster Clarks - 5ml
Milk Chocolate Chips - Hershey's - 90g

details.method:

powder. When thoroughly combined, stir in the chocolate chips, then sift in the cake mix. Gently stir it in, then split between the prepared
cake pans.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the center of the cake is baked through.
Flip cake rounds out carefully onto a wire rack to finish cooling, wrap up in plastic wrap, then store in the freezer until you're ready to
assemble the cake.
Then combine the chocolate ganache and the buttercream cheese.
Place down the first cake layer.
Add on a layer of chocolate buttercream, then the next cake layer, and repeat.
Crumb coat the cake and freeze for 3 minutes.
Add on some milk chocolate chips on top around the outside rim of the cake.

details.ingredients:

White Flour for Bread Production - MC4 - 1kg

Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 10g
Corn Starch - Mefsco - 100g
Eggs - Saeed Co. Farmer - 15g
Unsalted Natural Butter - Almarai - 50g
MR MAGIC CORN OIL - 1kg
Pistachio - Naseel - 200g
details.method:
In a medium saucepan over medium-high heat, combine together the water and butter. Bring to a boil.
Immediately add the flour mixture all at once, stirring constantly with a spatula or wooden spoon, until the dough is well combined,
comes together in one mass and pulls cleanly from the sides of the pan.
Turn out onto a plate, cover with plastic wrap and let it cool briefly until no longer hot; 15 to 20 minutes. It OK if its still warm.
Transfer the dough to a mixer fitted with the paddle attachment (or a bowl and spoon). With the mixer turned on medium speed, drop in
the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Make sure that each egg is incorporated before adding the next.
Transfer the dough to a pastry bag fitted with a medium or large star tip; ideally one with 16 points. The more the points of the tip, the
more the grooves the fritter will have, but any star tip will work,
In a frying pan (the larger it is, the faster you'll finish), pour enough oil to fill 1 inch/2.5 cm high. Heat the oil over medium until its very
warm. If you stick your finger in the oil, it should feel comfortably hot. Don't let it get too hot, or the fritter won't puff properly and the
texture will turn out less than perfect.
As soon as the oil reaches the right temperature, start piping the dough directly over the oil, into 2.5 inches/6cm fluted fingers, cutting
through with scissors. (Tip: Dip the scissors tips in oil for stick-free cutting). Don't overcrowd the pan as the fritters will expand
dramatically.
Still over medium heat, fry the fingers, turning them occasionally, until deep golden brown in color. The longer you fry them, the
crunchier they'll be on the outside, so be patient with them. Repeat with the second batch, but remove the frying pan from the heat and
allow the oil temperature to drop down again to very warm, before piping the rest.
Transfer the fritters to drain on some paper towels for a few minutes. Then while still hot, dip the fritters into the cool...

details.method:
Preheat the oven to 160*C.
Whisk ghee, sugar, eggs and blossom water together: In a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment or using a hand-held mixer, beat
the butter first on medium, then on high speed in a large bowl until creamy and light, about 3 minutes.
Scrape down the sides of the bowl and add the sugar, egg, and orange blossom water or vanilla extract. Beat until the mixture is thick,
pale, and creamy, another 2-3 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl once or twice during beating. Keep it aside.
If the dough stays on your fingertips when squeezed, it is too wet.
Add flour, stir and squeeze. If the dough feels dry (you ll see cracking),
add milk at a time, stir and squeeze.
Squeeze the dough as you work, until the dough is smooth, pliable, and soft.
Take a 1 ounce piece of dough, shape into a ball by rolling the dough between the palms of your hands.
Turn the mold face down and tap the top corner of the mold head firmly on the work surface (whack!) once or twice to release the
cookie.
Carefully transfer the cookie to the prepared baking sheet and place them 1-inch apart.
Shape a tablespoon of date paste into a log similar in shape but smaller than the flattened dough. Lay the log of date paste in the center
of the dough and cover the date filling by enclosing it in the dough and sealing the edges together up over the date paste log. Turn the
log over, continuing to smooth and shape the dough by hand into a log, ensuring there are no cracks. Use a fork to pinch the top of the
dough in a deep, decorative pattern, piercing all the way to the date filling.
Carefully transfer the cookies to the prepared baking sheets and place them 1 inch apart. Repeat the shaping process with a mold or by
hand with the rest of the dough and date filling. Bake the cookies, one sheet pan at a time, in the center of the oven, for 15-17 minutes.

Reduce the oven temperature to 160C.Butter a 23cm/9in springform cake tin and line the base with baking parchment.

hazelnuts aside.

nearly all the chocolate has melted, remove the bowl from the pan and continue to let the chocolate melt in the residual heat.

chocolate mixture until thoroughly combined. Wash and dry the beaters well.

sliding out. Do not over whisk.

of the whisked egg whites and stir until thoroughly combined, then gently fold in the remaining egg whites.

details.method:
Rinse a thick-bottomed pan or saucepan with clean water.
Pour milk into it and heat it on the stovetop medium-low to medium heat.
Stir a couple of times when the milk is getting heated so that the milk does not get burnt from the bottom.
When the milk comes to a boil, it will start rising. Switch off the heat before it spills out of the pan.
Set the pan aside on the kitchen countertop. Let the milk become warm at room temperature.
Check with a food thermometer if the milk becomes warm; the temperature should be between 34*C and 44*C.
Once the milk has become warm, you can use the same pan to set the curd or transfer the warm milk to another bowl.
Curd:
Add the yogurt to the milk and mix thoroughly with a small wired whisk.
Cover with a lid and allow the milk to ferment for 5 to 6 hours or until the curd is set.
Depending on the temperature, it may take more hours.
The curd will have a pleasant fermented aroma, a slightly tangy taste, and a wobbly thick texture on fermentation.
Once the curd is made, refrigerate it so it does not get over-fermented.
As soon as the curd is set and fermented well, cover it with a lid and place it in the refrigerator.

Bring to a simmer. Place the yolks in a mixing bowl, beat them.
Add granulated sugar and whisk until the mixture is combined.
To begin the tempering process, gradually ladle the hot milk and cream mixture into the mixing bowl one ladle at a time while whisking
continuously.
The aim is to gradually heat the egg yolks to the temperature of the warm milk and cream so as not to curdle the eggs.
When the temperature of the yolks is similar to the temperature of the milk and cream, whisk the contents of the mixing bowl into the
saucepot with the remaining vanilla cream.
Swap your whisk for a flat-bottom spoon and continue to stir as you cook to 85 C.
The cr me anglaise will be thickened and should coat the back of a spoon.
Test by swiping your finger across the back of the coated spoon. If the sauce is thickened, the swipe should remain and not be filled in
by runny sauce. Strain the cr me anglaise through a chinois into a mixing bowl resting in an ice bath. Remove the vanilla pod and set
aside for future use.

Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onions and saut until they turn translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and chopped green chilies, and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the ground cumin, ground coriander, and garam masala, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes and cook until they release their juices and start to break down, about 5-7 minutes.
Add diced paneer to the skillet and mix well.
Cook the mixture for another 5-7 minutes until the paneer is heated through and the flavors are well combined.
Season with salt to taste.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves if desired. Set aside.
Chili on the Side:
In a small bowl, combine the thinly sliced green chilies, lemon juice, and salt.
Mix well and set aside.
Sandwiches:
Preheat a sandwich press or griddle over medium heat.
Spread softened butter on one side of each slice of bread.
Place the bread slices butter side down on a clean work surface.
Spread a layer of Paneer Mixture on half of the bread slices.
Optionally, add a small amount of Chili on the Side on top of the paneer mixture.
Close the sandwiches with the remaining slices of bread, butter side up.

Kale, Jullienned - 1kg
Potato, Diced - 1kg
Onion, White, Diced - 200g
Celery, Diced - 100g
Carrots, Small Diced - 100g
Unsalted Natural Butter - Almarai - 100g
Vegetables Broth - 2kg
Cooking Cream - Almarai - 500ml
Iodized Table Salt - Sasa - 30g
Ground Black Pepper - FRESHLY - 10g
details.method:
In a large pot, heat the butter or olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions, celery, and carrots to the pot, and sauté until they are soft and translucent.
Add the diced potatoes to the pot, and continue to sauté for about 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable or chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer, cover the pot, and cook for about 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Add the chopped kale to the pot, and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes until the kale is wilted and tender.
Use an immersion blender or transfer the mixture to a blender, and blend until smooth.
Return the blended soup to the pot, and stir in the heavy cream.
Season with salt and pepper to taste

details.ingredients:

Coconut Milk - Alpro - 720ml

Cinnamon Powder - Naseel - 10g
Vanilla Flavour (Liquid) - Bakemate - 10g
Iodized Table Salt - Reihan - 4g
Margarine - 80g
details.method:
'In a shallow dish or baking pan, whisk together the plant-based milk, chickpea flour, maple syrup, ground flaxseed meal, ground
cinnamon, vanilla extract, and salt until well combined. This will be your French toast batter.
Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and lightly grease it with vegan butter or cooking oil.
Dip each slice of bread into the French toast batter, ensuring that both sides are well-coated but not soggy. Allow any excess batter to
drip off.
Place the dipped bread slices onto the preheated skillet or griddle. Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the cooked French toast slices from the skillet or griddle and place them on a serving platter or individual plates.

details.ingredients:
Pistachio Layer Cake Base - 1.49kg
Raspberry White Chocolate Buttercream - 100g
Raspberry Jam Base - 800g
Raspberries, Sanitized - 300g
details.method:
Place the first cake layer on your serving dish or cake board on your turntable.
Add a few scoops of the raspberry buttercream and with an offset spatula, even it out. Add half of the
remaining raspberry jam on top of the buttercream and even it out.
Add the next sponge layer and do the same as the previous layer. Then add the final cake layer and cover
the cake in a thin crumb coat. Place it in the freezer for 30 min, for the buttercream to set.
Add the remaining buttercream, and spread it out in an even layer. Scape down the sides of the cake to get
smooth sides on the cake. Place it back in the freezer for 10-15 min.
Once the 15 min has passed. Rinse a sharp knife and cut the uneven top off. Add any leftover buttercream in
the middle of the cake and add the fresh raspberries on top.

details.ingredients:
Nuts, Pecans - 200g
Eggs - Saeed Co. Farmer - 340g
Canola Oil - Noor - 200ml
Iodized Table Salt - Reihan - 5g
Cinnamon Powder - Naseel - 10g
Nutmeg, Ground - 10g
Baking Soda - Orient Gardens - 10g
Allspice, Ground - 10g
White Fine Sugar - Albayt - 200g
Bakery Flour - Foom - 500g
Water; Tap - Na - 200ml
Prunes, Pitted - 200g
White Fine Sugar - Albayt - 200g
Prune Cake Icing - 230g
details.method:
Combine prunes and water in a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until prunes are
tender, about 5 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a fluted tube pan.
Mix flour, sugar, allspice, baking soda, nutmeg, cinnamon, and salt together in a mixing bowl. Combine vegetable oil, buttermilk, and
eggs in a separate bowl; pour them into the flour mixture.
Mix until fully incorporated. Use an electric mixer to blend in the drained prunes; the mixer will break them up a bit. Stir in the chopped
pecans.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake in preheated oven until a tester comes out clean, about 45 minutes. Remove cake from oven and
allow it to cool for at least 10 minutes on a wire rack
Invert cake onto a platter and pour hot icing over the cake

details.ingredients:
Bechamel Sauce - 1kg
Beef Bolognese Sauce - 1kg
Lasagna (Pasta) - Goody - 1kg
Cheese, Mozzarella, Grated - 200g
Cheese, Parmesan, Grated - 200g
details.method:
Preheat oven to 180°C.
Use a baking dish.
Smear a bit of Bolognese sauce on the base, then cover with lasagna sheets. Tear sheets to fit.
Spread over Bolognese Sauce (enough to cover sheets), then drizzle over béchamel Sauce.
Top with lasagna sheets. Spread with another Bolognese, then Béchamel Sauce. Top with lasagna sheets then repeat one more time.
Top with a 4th layer of lasagna sheets, then pour over the remaining béchamel Sauce.
Sprinkle with Mozzarella and parmesan cheese, then bake for 25 minutes or until golden and bubbling.
Stand for 5 to 10 minutes before cutting and serving.

details.ingredients:

details.method:
Preheat oven to 180°C. Place cupcake papers in a cupcake pan.
In a large bowl, sift the dry ingredients together (including the sugar). Give it a whisk to combine.
Cut the room temperature butter into tablespoon-sized pieces then add to the dry mixture then mix on attachment until a sandy mixture
forms.
In another bowl, whisk together the eggs, buttermilk, vanilla, and food coloring.
Slowly add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients while mixing on low.
Mix until combined, scraping the bowl down as needed. Distribute the batter evenly into cake molds.
Bake at 180°C for 15-20 minutes or until springy to the touch.
Transfer buttercream to a piping bag fitted with a star tip and pipe large dollops on top of each

details.ingredients:

details.method:
'Preheat your oven to 180°C
In a bowl, mix together the honey, soy sauce, orange juice, brown sugar, minced garlic, grated ginger, and cloves to make the glaze.
Season the ducks with salt and pepper, both inside and out.
Place the ducks in a roasting pan or baking dish.
Pour the glaze over the ducks, ensuring they are evenly coated. Reserve some glaze for basting during cooking.
roast the ducks in the preheated oven for about 1.5 to 2 hours, basting occasionally with the reserved glaze, until the skin is golden
brown and crispy, and the internal temperature reaches 79°C
Once cooked, remove the ducks from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes before carving

details.method:
In a mixing bowl add chicken, yogurt ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, salt, red chili powder and garam masala, mix them well, cover and set aside
until needed.
Heat a pan with oil ad add cardamoms, sliced onion and fry them evenly until golden brown, add cashews and almonds, cool completely and blend
along with yogurt until get a smooth puree. You may add a splash of water to help blend it if you want. On the same pan add oil and sauté the
whole spices for a minute, add green chili and marinated chicken. Sauté on a medium heat for 6 minutes, then add the previous puree and hot
water. Add salt, coriander powder and garam masala. if required you can also add more chili powder for color. Mix well and bring to boil, reduce
the heat, cover and cook on low heat until chicken is cooked and you see traces of oil over the korma. Garnish with coriander leaves.

details.method:
Put the masala gravy in a pan and let it simmer for 5 minutes then carefully put the fish pieces and cook covered on a medium heat.
Carefully flip or turn the pieces to the other side after 3 to 4 mins. Cook until the fish pieces bulge a bit. This is the indication they are
cooked completely. Taste the curry and add more salt if needed. Garnish the fish curry with coriander leaves.

details.method:
Make 3-4 lengthwise slits on the eggs and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, when it splutters, add finely chopped onion, green chilies and curry leaves. Sauté until onions turn
transparent. Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for a few more minutes. Add tomatoes, turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder,
salt needed and cook until tomatoes become soft and mushy. If you feel it is too dry, add 2 tbsp of water.
Then add the hard boiled eggs, sprinkle pepper powder and mix until it is well coated with the masala.
Remove from heat and garnish with finely chopped coriander leaves

details.method:
Cut the fish fillet into cubes.
Sizzle black mustard seeds: Heat oil over medium heat in a large pot. Add black mustard seeds and let them sizzle for 30 seconds -
careful, they might pop!
Sauté the red onion and cook for 3 minutes until golden. Add curry paste and cook for 3 minutes - to evaporate water, make spices
bloom and cook garlic & ginger.
Turn heat up to medium high. Add tomato paste and tomato pulp, cook for 2 minutes.
Add water, coconut milk, sugar, salt and chili powder. Stir, then bring to simmer, low heat so it's bubbling gently.
Simmer for 2 minutes, add tomato and green chili.
Simmer for another 3 minutes, stirring every now and then.
Add fish, stir, cook for 3 to 4 minutes until fish easily flakes.
Remove from stove and transfer to serving dish. Garnish with coriander and fresh green chilies.

details.method:
Heat oil in a medium skillet. Add bay leaf and onions. Sauté on medium heat until the onions turn light golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes. Use a
lid to speed up cooking while mixing in the onions frequently. Add ginger paste, garlic paste, and green chili. Mix well and cook for another minute.
Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes stirring a few times until the tomatoes are soft and mushy.
Mix well with Chana masala spice blend, salt, turmeric, and red chili powder. Add boiled chickpeas along with the water from pressure cooking.
Add one cup of water(more or less) to bring the curry to your desired consistency

details.method:
Heat a pan on low-medium heat, once hot, add oil. Once the oil heats up add some red chili powder and turmeric, sauté for about 30
seconds, add the boiled eggs and swirl them for 2-3 min until the exterior is lightly browned.
Remove the eggs from the pan and set aside.
Heat the same pan on medium heat, add oil and once hot add mustard seeds and cumin seeds and sauté for 30 seconds, now add curry
leaves and green chilies. The curry leaves it will splutter so cover the pan. Now add onion, season them with salt and sauté until lightly
brown, add ginger and garlic after a minute or two add the tomatoes and season with salt, cover with a lid and cook the tomatoes for 10
min on low-medium heat. Stir Occasionally to prevent the tomatoes from burning. Add some water to deglaze the pan, add powdered
spices and keep cooking for a minute, add the eggs, add some water and keep cooking for 4 minutes more on medium heat. Add garam
masala, Kasoori Methi and fresh cilantro.

details.method:
Add the oil and sauté the chopped onion in a pot until golden. Then add the fresh coriander, garlic, and sauté for a few more minutes to

lower the heat to a simmer for around 20 minutes until the pumpkin is well cooked. Taste and adjust the seasoning before turning off the
heat.

details.method:
Combine the milk powder and the water together.
Heat the milk until it is warm but not hot, about 90 degrees. In a large bowl, combine it with the yeast. Stir lightly, and let sit until the
mixture is foamy, about 5 minutes.
Using a stand mixer fitted with a dough hook, beat the eggs, butter, sugar and salt into the yeast mixture. Add half of the flour and mix
until combined, then mix in the rest of the flour until the dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl.
Add more flour, if the dough is too wet, the dough will probably become too thick to beat; when it does, transfer it to a floured surface,
and gently knead it until smooth. Grease a large bowl with a little oil. Transfer the dough to the bowl, and cover. Let rise at room
temperature until it doubles in size, about 1 hour.
Turn the dough out onto a well-floured surface, and roll. Cut out the doughnuts with a doughnut cutter, flouring the cutters as you go.
Reserve the doughnut holes. Knead any scraps together, being careful not to overwork,
and let rest for a few minutes before repeating the process.
Put the doughnuts on two floured baking sheets so that there is plenty of room between each one. Cover with a kitchen towel, and let
rise in a warm place until they are slightly puffed up and delicate, about 45 minutes.
About 15 minutes before the doughnuts are done rising, put the oil in a heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium heat, and heat
it to 190°C.
Meanwhile, line cooling racks, baking sheets or plates with paper towels.
Carefully add the doughnuts to the oil, a few at a time, When the bottoms are deep golden, after 45 seconds to a minute, use a slotted
spoon to flip; cook until they’re deep golden all over.
Doughnut holes cook faster. Transfer the doughnuts to the prepared plates or racks, and repeat with the rest of the dough, adjusting
the heat as needed to keep the oil at 190°C.
Glaze the doughnut by dipping them donuts into strawberry frosting 1-3 times.

Add the chicken in. Fry this, stirring constantly until the chicken begins to take on a golden colour in some places.
Add in the ginger-garlic paste. Give this a fry alongside the chicken, again stirring constantly and ensuring nothing burns. Continue to fry this until
the raw smell of the ginger and garlic begins to fade.
Add all the chopped tomatoes and spices. Stir in and allow this all to cook on high, stirring to ensure nothing catches at the bottom of the pan.
Continue to cook this for about 20 minutes, over a high heat. The oil will separate, the tomatoes will thicken and begin to coat the chicken, and you
will see holes begin to bubble in the gravy. The chicken should be cooked through at this point once the oil rises to the top and you see the holes

details.ingredients:

Minced Beef Filling For Kibbeh Bil Sayniye - 1kg

details.method:
Grease a large baking pan (32 cm) with some olive oil.
Divide the kibbeh mixture into two halves. Evenly spread one half in the greased pan by flattening small portions of the mixture with your
oiled hands to make a layer about ½ cm thick. Evenly spread the reserved stuffing over the first layer, pressing it slightly with your hand.
Cover with the remaining kibbeh by taking small portions at a time and flattening them with your slightly oiled hands. Press and smooth
the surface with your hand. You might also need to moisten your hand with cold water.
With a thin-pointed knife, cut the second layer into quarters or 8 portions. Make a crisscross pattern on the surface of each portion.
Pierce the pattern with the tip of a sharp knife to allow oil to seep down. Pinch a hole with your index finger in the middle and pour the
olive oil.
Preheat oven (175°C). Bake on the second lower rack for about 1 hour or until nicely brown.
